title: Heat adaptation document registry
description: Registry structure defined in DESIGN.md Appendix A.
$comment: Use a format checker to validate calendar dates. Python must also check cross-entry uniqueness, source URL syntax, project-relative paths, file existence, and PDF checksum agreement.

schema_version.description: Version of the saved registry structure.

plans.description: Registered document versions; an empty registry is valid.

plan_id.description: Identifier assigned to one registered document version.

pdf_path.description: Project-relative path to the preserved original PDF.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the original PDF as 64 hexadecimal characters.

source_url.description: Official source URL supplied during collection; URL syntax checks are performed by Python.

date_accessed.description: Date the source was accessed, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

study_set.description: Study set assigned to the document; development plans stay outside comparison.

prepared_source_path.description: Project-relative path to a preserved source.json preparation, or null until preparation exists.
